Constraints.Name: CK_complaint_handling_authority
Constraints.Definition: CHECK (((("AuthorizationGrantId" IS NULL) AND ("AuthorizationSourceReference" IS NULL) AND (("HandlingMode")::text = 'Ds'::text) AND (("Operation")::text = ANY ((ARRAY['StartInvestigation'::character varying, 'RecordNote'::character varying, 'RequestInformation'::character varying, 'RecordFindings'::character varying, 'DsReviewRecorded'::character varying])::text[]))) OR (("AuthorizationGrantId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("AuthorizationSourceReference" IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim(("AuthorizationSourceReference")::text)) > 0))))

Constraints.Name: CK_complaint_handling_evidence
Constraints.Definition:
CHECK (
CASE
    WHEN (jsonb_typeof("EvidenceReferencesJson") = 'array'::text) THEN (jsonb_array_length("EvidenceReferencesJson") <= 20)
    ELSE false
END)

Constraints.Name: CK_complaint_handling_operation
Constraints.Definition: CHECK ((("Operation")::text = ANY ((ARRAY['TakeDirect'::character varying, 'AssignDs'::character varying, 'ReassignDs'::character varying, 'StartInvestigation'::character varying, 'RecordNote'::character varying, 'RequestInformation'::character varying, 'RecordFindings'::character varying, 'Resolve'::character varying, 'Close'::character varying, 'Reopen'::character varying, 'DsReviewRecorded'::character varying])::text[])))

Constraints.Name: CK_complaint_handling_responsibility
Constraints.Definition: CHECK ((((("HandlingMode")::text = 'Commissioner'::text) AND ("ResponsibleActorId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("AssignmentEventId" IS NULL) AND (("ToState")::text = ANY ((ARRAY['UnderCommissionerReview'::character varying, 'InformationRequested'::character varying, 'UnderInvestigation'::character varying, 'Reopened'::character varying])::text[]))) OR ((("HandlingMode")::text = 'Ds'::text) AND ("ResponsibleActorId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("AssignmentEventId" IS NOT NULL) AND (("ToState")::text = ANY ((ARRAY['AssignedToDs'::character varying, 'InformationRequested'::character varying, 'UnderInvestigation'::character varying])::text[]))) OR ((("HandlingMode")::text = 'None'::text) AND ("ResponsibleActorId" IS NULL) AND ("AssignmentEventId" IS NULL) AND (("ToState")::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Resolved'::character varying, 'Closed'::character varying])::text[])))))

Constraints.Name: CK_complaint_handling_revision
Constraints.Definition: CHECK (((("Revision" = 1) AND ("PreviousEventId" IS NULL)) OR (("Revision" > 1) AND ("PreviousEventId" IS NOT NULL))))

Constraints.Name: CK_complaint_handling_states
Constraints.Definition: CHECK (((("FromState")::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Unassigned'::character varying, 'UnderCommissionerReview'::character varying, 'AssignedToDs'::character varying, 'InformationRequested'::character varying, 'UnderInvestigation'::character varying, 'Resolved'::character varying, 'Closed'::character varying, 'Reopened'::character varying])::text[])) AND (("ToState")::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Unassigned'::character varying, 'UnderCommissionerReview'::character varying, 'AssignedToDs'::character varying, 'InformationRequested'::character varying, 'UnderInvestigation'::character varying, 'Resolved'::character varying, 'Closed'::character varying, 'Reopened'::character varying])::text[]))))

Constraints.Definition: CHECK ((("ContentType")::text = ANY ((ARRAY['application/pdf'::character varying, 'image/png'::character varying, 'image/jpeg'::character varying, 'text/plain'::character varying])::text[])))

Constraints.Name: ck_screening_verification_revision
Constraints.Definition: CHECK ((("Revision" > 0) AND ((("Revision" = 1) AND ("PreviousEventId" IS NULL) AND (("PreviousStatus")::text = 'Unverified'::text)) OR (("Revision" > 1) AND ("PreviousEventId" IS NOT NULL)))))

Constraints.Name: ck_screening_verification_status
Constraints.Definition: CHECK (((("Status")::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Verified'::character varying, 'Rejected'::character varying, 'MoreInformationRequired'::character varying])::text[])) AND (("PreviousStatus")::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Unverified'::character varying, 'Verified'::character varying, 'Rejected'::character varying, 'MoreInformationRequired'::character varying])::text[]))))
